details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from the official oven-sh/bun GitHub release and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript payload (math_init.js). The payload is obfuscated with a custom string-array decoder and contains eval, Function, and child_process calls, running arbitrary code at install time. The package also depends on two sibling packages (@or-sdk/base, @or-sdk/providers) that carry the same malicious payload family. The obfuscated payload's network endpoints are encoded and not recoverable from the shipped source.
